text:
Alex P: FYI PR #427 (migration guide + TS SDK snippet) is up for review. Vercel preview looks mostly fine but favicon returns 404 and the CSS source map mismatch is flagged. Target merge in the Wed maintenance slot 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Can infra + a couple reviewers sanity-check the preview/CI?

Chris M: I can review. Post the preview link here when it's ready.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Vercel deploy started for PR #427 63; preview: https://pr-427-docs-redwood.vercel.app 63; status: warning (missing asset /favicon.ico, CSS sourcemap mismatch).

docs-bot: Docs checks: md-lint: pass. linkcheck: 1 broken internal anchor (#migration-steps-local) reported.

Sam T: Local repro notes I posted on the PR:
```
# using our repo scripts
git fetch origin pull/427/head:pr/427
git checkout pr/427
npm ci
npm run docs:preview   # runs mkdocs under the hood for dev
# or to match Vercel static build
npm run docs:build && python -m http.server --directory site 9000
```
If favicon 404 locally, check docs root (docs/) and mkdocs.yml `extra`/static paths. Also `vercel dev` is handy to mimic Vercel routing.

Lina S: Small functional request on the TS snippet: change `newClient({ apiKey })` to `createClient({ apiKey })` and update the param order (baseUrl first). I'll paste a suggested replacement.

Infra Bot: Quick scan: looks like absolute pathing issue. Vercel serves static files from `/public` so referencing `/favicon.ico` requires favicon in `docs/` root or `public/`. Suggest copying favicon to `docs/` and to `public/` fallback. CSS sourcemap warning is non-blocking but please regenerate maps during build.

Alex P: Pushed branch `fix/favicon-and-snippet` with two changes: copied `favicon.ico` to `docs/` and updated the TS snippet per Lina. Redeploying now.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Re-deploy started for branch fix/favicon-and-snippet 63 deploy id vcl-789 63 status: in_progress.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Deploy finished 63 preview: https://pr-427-docs-redwood.vercel.app 63 status: success. Asset checks: favicon resolved, CSS sourcemap warning eliminated.

Chris M: Reviewing now. The TS snippet change looks good, but I asked for one tiny rename (client -> redwoodClient) for clarity.

Alex P: Renamed to `redwoodClient` and force-pushed.

Chris M: Approved. :white_check_mark: Left an approving review and a nit about a trailing whitespace in the migration markdown.

Sam T: Added a local checklist comment on the PR for future authors:
1) `npm run docs:preview` to sanity-check dev routing
2) `npm run docs:build && python -m http.server --directory site 9000` to mirror static output
3) `vercel dev` to mimic production routing when using Vercel
4) run linkcheck (`markdown-link-check` in CI) and fix internal anchors
5) smoke test code samples in a TS REPL or `ts-node`

Lina S: LGTM from content side. Thanks for quick turnaround.

Alex P: Scheduling merge during the maintenance window 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Added release note to PR: "docs: fix favicon path and adjust TS SDK snippet" and included the local checklist.

Infra Bot: Reminder: if merge happens outside the window, notify infra channel so we can watch for routing cache weirdness.

Alex P: Noted. Will only merge in the window and will post here when done. Closing thread after merge.
